items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Was that by, by Flava? Do you remember one name? No, I don't remember.

ctx.x: You said that was a dance album? It was a dance? Yeah, it was a dance. What, did they sell tickets? Yeah.
Was that by, by Flava? Do you remember one name? No, I don't remember.
So on that job, you mostly just played the melody, huh?
